exposure: 2 ml isobaric levobupivacaine 5mg/ml (10mg) with fentanyl 15mg for spinal anaesthesia
Hyperbaric bupivacaine 10 mg with fentanyl 15mg for spinal anaesthesia
cohort: Sixty patients aged 20 to 40 years undergoing lower segment cesarean section were divided into two groups of 30 each.
finding: Levobupivacaine with fentanyl combination provides shorter motor block time and a longer duration until first rescue analgesia compared to hyperbaric bupivacaine with fentanyl in spinal anaesthesia for cesarean section.
followup_time: Up to 273.40 minutes after skin closure for rescue analgesia
